name: export-risk-guard
install: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix miniapp install && cp -n backend/.env.example backend/.env 2>/dev/null || true; cd backend && DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db" npx prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db" npm run seed

terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db" PORT=3000 npm run start:dev

terminals.name: miniapp-h5
terminals.command: cd miniapp && VITE_API_BASE=/api npm run dev:h5
